quote_mismatches.quote: Up to now ten HVSs are known that have Galactic rest-frame velocities exceeding the escape velocity of the Galaxy and are therefore unbound. To date only one of those, the subluminous O star US 708 (Hirsch et al. 2005), belongs to an old population of evolved stars.
